resources.string: All battlespace models on the map, rendered TacticalData-style with MIL-STD-2525 symbols.
Build a model, stage it on the map (consume), then persist + broadcast (commit) or discard (rollback).
Create models with different MIL-STD-2525 symbol keys and affiliations.
Observe selectedModel, userModel and collection events; select, follow and unselect.
No models on the map yet.

createModel() builds a model but does not show or save it. consumeModel() visualizes it on the map and stages it as a pending LOCAL change — it is NOT written to the database and NOT broadcast to other nodes, so it can be discarded with rollback. commitModel() persists the staged model to the database AND broadcasts it to remote nodes. In short: consume = preview locally; commit = save & share.

The symbol key is an Int handle into the MIL-STD-2525 binding table, passed via ModelAttrs.symbolKey. The affiliation (color/frame) is the orthogonal ModelAttrs.hostility. Tap Create to build + consume each example at the current map position.
